_doc: The creator's money ceilings, enforced in code (explainer_engine/core/spend_caps.py, D-56). A run ledger may set lower caps, never higher; a pod is refused when it would pass any RunPod line. Raise a number only on the creator's word.

allowances._doc: Spending a tool may do on its own, without asking first: a ceiling inside the run's own cap of that service (never a raise of it; the cap's 80 % stop still applies). Enforced by core/ledger.Run.reserve_allowance.

qa_loop.for: re-reads of script lines the QA loop changed (explainer_engine/qa/loop.py)

_runpod_note: 2026-10-24 (the creator's OK on the strategy): money is capped per JOB (per_pod_usd, the guard stops there) and cards are picked by the job's estimated cost (runpod.pick_gpus); max_price_per_hour is only the runaway ceiling of one card.
